# Bolero source files (*.bo) are built, run, tested, vetted, covered,
# formatted and listed like Go source files.

go list -f '{{.GoFiles}} {{.TestGoFiles}} {{.XTestGoFiles}}' ./colors
stdout '^\[colors.bo hex.go\] \[colors_test.bo\] \[go_test.go\]$'

go build . ./colors ./relay
go run .
stdout '^F00 3$'
go run main.bo
stdout '^F00 3$'

go test ./colors
stdout '^ok'
go test -cover ./colors
stdout 'coverage: [0-9.]+% of statements'

go vet . ./colors ./relay
go fmt ./colors
! stdout .

# go mod tidy finds the imports of Bolero source files.
! grep 'rsc.io/quote' go.mod
go mod tidy -e
grep 'rsc.io/quote' go.mod

# cgo is not supported in Bolero source files.
! go build ./cgo
stderr 'use of cgo in Bolero file .*c.bo not supported'

# Go source files cannot use declarations from Bolero source files:
# not in the same package,
! go build ./mixed
stderr 'BoFunc is declared in a Bolero file and cannot be used in Go files'

# not from another package, including methods declared in Bolero source
# files on types declared in Go source files,
! go build ./gouser
stderr 'Red is declared in a Bolero file and cannot be used in Go files'
stderr 'Size is declared in a Bolero file and cannot be used in Go files'
! stderr 'HexOf'

# and not through a package that only re-exports Go declarations.
! go build ./gorelay
stderr 'Size is declared in a Bolero file and cannot be used in Go files'

# go vet (go/types) enforces the same rule from export data.
! go vet ./gouser
stderr 'Red is declared in a Bolero file and cannot be used in Go files'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.26
-- main.bo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/m/colors"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(colors.Red().Hex(), colors.Palette{}.Size())
}
-- colors/colors.bo --
package colors

type Color int

func Red() Color { return 0 }

func (c Color) Hex() string { return HexOf(int(c)) }

func (Palette) Size() int { return len(palette) }
-- colors/hex.go --
package colors

type Palette struct{}

var palette = []string{"F00", "0F0", "00F"}

func HexOf(i int) string { return palette[i] }
-- colors/colors_test.bo --
package colors

import "testing"

func TestHex(t *testing.T) {
	if got := Red().Hex(); got != "F00" {
		t.Errorf("Red().Hex() = %q, want F00", got)
	}
}
-- colors/go_test.go --
package colors_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/m/colors"
)

func TestHexOf(t *testing.T) {
	if got := colors.HexOf(1); got != "0F0" {
		t.Errorf("HexOf(1) = %q, want 0F0", got)
	}
}
-- relay/relay.go --
package relay

import "example.com/m/colors"

func Palette() colors.Palette { return colors.Palette{} }
-- quoteuser/q.bo --
package quoteuser

import _ "rsc.io/quote"
-- cgo/c.bo --
package cgo

import "C"
-- mixed/a.bo --
package mixed

func BoFunc() {}
-- mixed/b.go --
package mixed

var _ = BoFunc
-- gouser/gouser.go --
package gouser

import "example.com/m/colors"

var _ = colors.HexOf(0)
var _ = colors.Red()
var _ = colors.Palette{}.Size()
-- gorelay/gorelay.go --
package gorelay

import "example.com/m/relay"

var _ = relay.Palette().Size()
